title: Abstract evaluator update
statement: Given an evaluator configuration and an action, the update either returns an output Boolean or a new configuration. If the action has no next state, it outputs the action's symbol, using false when that symbol is absent. A read action sets the phase to its specified phase, optionally marks the current head cell, and advances the head by one exactly when the head move is positive. A value-rewind action with a specified phase performs the same optional marking and resets the head to zero. An append action appends its Boolean value to the computed values, clears the marked cells, resets the head to zero, and sets the phase to the gate-evaluation phase; every other action returns false.
